statement: No intersections at 41 checked poses; Ø44 projected barrel corridor clear of non-probe parts.
validation_scope: All 48 components are valid single solids and passed STEP roundtrip checks. No intersections at 41 checked poses; Ø44 projected barrel corridor clear of non-probe parts. Each pose includes all 1128 component pairs, with no excluded parts or regions. The alternative full-length Ø6 mm probe was checked against every other component. The independent continuous optical report validates the final world-space transform. Physical collision checks are sampled; strength, stiffness, backlash and print fit need physical validation.
